title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.26825v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. translated_abstract: 记忆原生演化要求将记忆作为基础模型的内在能力，使其能够持续积累和利用信息。为此，我们提出了MemT-1.0，一种将记忆内化为模型计算一部分的记忆基础模型新架构。MemT-1.0基于Metis构建，采用Gated DeltaNet-2，并在每一轮内使用稳定的token级记忆更新机制。我们进一步引入Mixture-of-Storage（存储混合）来扩展原生记忆容量。在经过精心准备的主干模型之后，我们开发了一个由继续预训练和后训练组成的两阶段训练流程，并由340亿（34B）token的训练数据以及高效的训练与推理基础设施支撑。我们发布了包含MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash的模型家族，并对记忆能力和通用能力进行了全面评估。结果表明，它们在（各项评估中）优于参数化记忆基线。
tldr: MemT-1.0提出了一种将记忆内化为基础模型固有计算能力的新架构，通过Gated DeltaNet-2、稳定的token级记忆更新机制和Mixture-of-Storage来扩展原生记忆容量，其发布的模型家族在记忆与通用能力评估中超越了参数化记忆基线。
en_tdlr: MemT-1.0 is a new memory foundation model architecture that internalizes memory as an intrinsic part of model computation, leveraging Gated DeltaNet-2 with stable token-level memory updates and Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity, with its released model family outperforming parametric memory baselines on memory and general capability evaluations.
